method.main_force_rule: broker families are deduplicated by stock; candidate/confirmed grades require repeat wins, lift above baseline, a one-sided binomial chance check, and at least one observed rotation
method.rotation_rule: the next qualified position begins from 45 days before to 180 days after a completed +100% exit
method.collaboration_rule: different broker families must co-occur in at least two qualified early-position events
method.exit_100: first close after the entry window at or above 2x estimated weighted average buy price
method.transfer_200_candidate: price reached 3x and the symbol disappeared from the emerging dataset at least 90 calendar days before its end
method.left_censor_rule: symbols already present on the first archive date are excluded
method.warning: A disappearance is not proof of a TWSE/TPEx transfer. Official listing dates are required before candidates become confirmed.
